Multiphoton microscopy was used to visualize ovarian neoplasm, derived in vitro. Distorted ovarian body appears in white with blue follicles, collagen and elastin fibers in green as second harmonic generation. Highly autofluorescent fat emerges in various hues of blue and gray.

The initial formation of callus looks like a small swelling at the edge of the explant or on the part that has been cut. Observation using a loupe can help determine the first time callus forms, and help see contamination in plant explants that may be missed by the eye.
